provider: Ahrefs Keywords Explorer and SERP Overview, country=mx
verdict_rule: the same rule the other three admission files use, families judged on all their keywords merged.
why_this_market: Third in the materialisation order and third on the numbers. The first ranking scored it on 16 keywords and 31,050 volume; 30 keywords read on 2026-10-05 put it at about 270,000. Like en-AU it needs no new language, so the implementation cost is one line in MARKETS, one origin city and one capture.

keywords.keyword: que hacer en san miguel de allende
que hacer en valle de bravo

what_the_measurement_settles: The named-entity family is the whole market: chichen itza 91,000, teotihuacan 39,000, palenque 19,000, museo frida kahlo 9,000. Mexico has a denser set of world-famous named archaeological sites than any other candidate, and this inventory already has a family for exactly that page type.

The city family reaches eighteen cities and runs down to Campeche 800 and Morelia 700, with thirteen of them at keyword difficulty 0 or 1: Guadalajara 7,400 at ZERO, Monterrey 5,300, Merida 4,100 at ZERO, Queretaro 3,800, Cancun 3,500. Patzcuaro at 80 and difficulty 56 is the one below the floor and is recorded as such.
Outdoor entities carry high volume at difficulty ZERO: pico de orizaba 14,000, hierve el agua 12,000 at a CPC of fifty cents, popocatepetl 8,600.

esim mexico reads 6,700 at a CPC of ONE DOLLAR and keyword difficulty ZERO. That is the second most valuable connectivity keyword in the ranking behind esim australia at $3.50, and it is the easier of the two.

activities.city-things-to-do.reading: lotuseaters.travel at DOMAIN RATING 16 holds position 3 with 944 traffic and ONE backlink. visitmerida.mx DR 40 at 4, zonaturistica DR 49 at 5, anadventurousworld DR 39 at 6 with ZERO backlinks, and GetYourGuide DR 90 only at 7. An AI Overview sits above citing YouTube, Instagram and Tripadvisor. Three mid-authority pages with no links between them, and the large OTA below all of them.

serp_evidence.what_is_not_sampled: One SERP, on the city family. The named-entity family that carries most of this market's volume is NOT sampled: chichen itza at 91,000 and difficulty 24 is a SERP that needs its own reading, and so does esim mexico at a one dollar CPC.

duplication_risk_measured_not_assumed: es-MX shares /es/ with es-ES and ADDS pages, on the same measured basis as en-AU: every URL belongs to exactly one market and distinct URLs per language equals rows per language exactly. Chichen Itza, Teotihuacan, Monterrey, Merida, Oaxaca, Guanajuato and Valle de Bravo are entities es-ES does not reach, because Mexico had no home market until now.
implementation_cost: LOW. No new language. One line in MARKETS, Mexico City in ORIGIN, this file in the keyword overlay, and the capture that is second in the market-candidate queue.
blocking_dependency: the Mexican OSM layers, second in osm-market-candidate-queue.sh behind Australia.
